entities.name: Siroheme synthase (CysG)
observations: 476-aa query is 61.1% identical over 96.2% coverage to reviewed Pseudomonas syringae siroheme synthase Q4ZRL6.
Homolog annotation assigns SAM-dependent uroporphyrinogen III methylation, NAD-dependent precorrin-2 dehydrogenation, and sirohydrochlorin ferrochelation.
Query Pfam hits include NAD_binding_7, CysG_dimeriser, and TP_methylase domains. Sequence-based assignment; not experimentally verified for this query.

entities.name: Uroporphyrinogen methylation
observations: Uroporphyrinogen III + 2 S-adenosyl-L-methionine = precorrin-2 + 2 S-adenosyl-L-homocysteine + H+ (Rhea:32459); proceeds via precorrin-1 and methylates positions C-2 and C-7.

entities.name: Precorrin-2 dehydrogenation
observations: Precorrin-2 + NAD+ = sirohydrochlorin + NADH + 2 H+ (Rhea:15613; EC 1.3.1.76).

entities.name: Siroheme biosynthesis
observations: Siroheme synthase homologs are annotated in the siroheme biosynthesis pathway; related annotations also link the enzyme to cobalamin biosynthesis.
